guide: Open Start and type your shop name and your own limits in the yellow cells: target margin, floor margin, packaging and picking cost, items in an order and the days that count as recent.
List your suppliers on Suppliers with their freight and duty rates, then your products on Products with unit cost, weight and the five channel prices. Landed cost fills in.
Check Channel Fees. One row for each channel and fee rule: commission, payment fee, fixed fee, payout days and shipping charge.
Fill Packaging and Handling, Carriers, Shipping Allowance and Return Allowance. They feed the costs of every margin.
Read Margin by Channel. Each SKU and channel shows the margin, a verdict and the price needed for the target and the floor.
Set Target Margins by category and channel group, then read the verdict of each one.
Record every supplier rise on Cost Changes and every price move on Price History. Cost Changes shows whether prices followed.
Use Price Requests, Price Tests, Competitor Prices, Bundles, Promo Price Plan, Wholesale Tiers, Customers and Launch Plan for the pricing decisions of the year.
Use the 14 calculators for landed cost, price, order margin, floor price, cost rise, discount depth, tax, bundles, markup, shipping, returns, wholesale price, free shipping and what-if.
Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and tap a message link to open WhatsApp with the text ready.
Read Pricing Dashboard and Charts every week: margins, under-floor lines, cost rises, price changes and competitor gaps.

listing.title: Online Seller Pricing Excel Template: Landed Cost, Margin by Channel, Price History, Cost Changes, Bundles, Wholesale Tiers
listing.headline: Know what every product really earns on every channel
listing.description:
Price every product of your online shop with real numbers in one Excel workbook. Products holds each SKU with its supplier, weight and the five channel prices, and landed cost fills in from your freight and duty rates. Margin by Channel then shows what each SKU earns on the own web shop, two marketplaces, a social shop and wholesale after fees, packaging, picking, shipping and returns, with a verdict and the price needed for your target and your floor.

Channel Fees, Packaging and Handling, Carriers, Shipping Allowance and Return Allowance feed those costs. Target Margins compares the margin you reach with the margin you want for each category.

Cost Changes records every supplier rise and shows whether your prices followed. Price History keeps every price change, Price Requests checks the margin at a requested price before the owner decides, and Price Tests tells you which price earned more. Competitor Prices, Bundles, Promo Price Plan, Wholesale Tiers, Customers and Launch Plan cover the rest of the pricing year.

14 calculators cover landed cost, price from a target margin, order margin, floor price, cost rise, discount depth, price with sales tax, bundles, markup, shipping, returns, wholesale price, free shipping and a price and units what-if. Print 10 sheets and 10 documents, follow 10 checklists and send 28 WhatsApp messages that open with the details already written in.

This is part one of the Online Seller suite. A standard .xlsx workbook with no macros and no subscription, 15 languages in one purchase, with a demo copy full of sample data for a home and gift shop to explore first. It helps you plan your pricing and does not promise results.

competitors.lacks: multiply cost by a markup and never include channel fees, shipping, packaging or returns, so the margin shown is too high
work out one order on one channel at a time and keep no product list, cost log or price history
charge every month and focus on stock; the margin per channel is hard to see and not explained
records the profit after the sale, so you cannot see that a price loses money before you set it
cannot add up costs, warn about a supplier cost rise or compare prices with the floor margin

messages.moment: Supplier: your cost rise needs a reason
messages.text: Hello, your cost rise on {sku} from {old_cost} to {new_cost} ({change_pct}) needs a written reason. Please send it with the date the new cost applies.
Hello {contact}, please send a new quote for {service} with unit cost, minimum units, lead time and freight and duty basis. Our usual lead time with you is {lead_days} days.

messages.moment: Supplier: confirm freight and duty basis
messages.text: Hello {contact}, please confirm the freight rate ({freight_pct}) and the duty rate ({duty_pct}) you use on our goods, and who pays each.
Hello {contact}, we want to add a new product from {name}. Please send one sample with the unit cost, weight and carton size.
Hello {contact}, your minimum of {moq_units} units is high for us. Can you lower it for the next order or split the delivery?
Hello, please confirm how long the new cost of {new_cost} for {sku} is valid. We want to order before {date}.
Hello {contact}, we plan a larger order for the next season. What discount do you give for bigger quantities and what is the lead time of {lead_days} days then?
Hello, we confirm the new cost of {new_cost} for {sku} from {date}. Please confirm the same figures on your side before we order.
Hello, {product} on {channel} has a margin of {margin_pct} and the floor is {floor_pct}. The price for the floor is {floor_price}. Please check cost and price today.

messages.moment: Operations manager: cost rise to apply
messages.text: Hello, the cost of {sku} rises from {old_cost} to {new_cost} on {date}. Passed on to prices: {pass_state}. Please prepare the price change.
Hello, please check the landed cost of {sku}: unit cost {unit_cost}, landed cost {landed_cost}, freight and duty {freight_duty}.
Hello, {carrier} sent new rates for {service}, zone {zone}. Please compare them with our shipping allowance and tell me what changes.
Hello, the price of {sku} on {channel} changes from {old_price} to {new_price} on {date}. Please update the listing, the images with prices and the next newsletter.
Hello, we launch {product} on {planned_launch}. Please prepare the photos and the text at least two weeks before.
Hello, the bundle {name} is ready at {bundle_price} on {channel}. It saves the customer {saving_pct}. Please list it from {on_sale_from}.
Hello, the price review for {category} ({grp}) is ready. Average margin now {avg_margin}, target {target}. Verdict: {state}. Please read it before we meet.
Hello, {product} on {channel} has a margin of {margin_pct} per unit sold. Verdict: {verdict}. Please decide whether we change the price or stop selling it there.
Hello, a price request for {sku} on {channel} is waiting: from {cur_price} to {requested_price}. Margin at the request {new_margin}. Please decide.
Hello {contact}, our wholesale price list for {name} is updated. Please check your tier ({tier}) and tell us if anything looks wrong.

messages.moment: Wholesale customer: new product in range
messages.text: Hello {contact}, we have new products in our range. Your terms stay at {terms_days} days. Would you like the sheet?
Hello {contact}, your tier for {name} is now {tier} with a discount of {tier_discount}. The minimum order is {min_order}.
Hello {contact}, some of our prices rise soon because supplier costs rose. We will send the new list. Orders confirmed before the change keep the old price.
Hello {contact}, we have a bundle offer for your shop. Tell us your tier ({tier}) and we will send the prices.
Hello {contact}, the minimum order for your tier ({tier}) is now {min_order}. Please tell us if this causes a problem.
Hello, we want to review our rates for {service}, zone {zone}. Our rates were last checked on {checked}. Please send the current rate card.
Hello, please explain the fuel surcharge of {fuel_pct} and the minimum charge of {min_charge} on {service}, zone {zone}.

messages.moment: Team member: promo prices go live
messages.text: Hello, promo prices go live on {starts} for {sku} on {channel}: {promo_price}. The promotion ends on {ends}. Please change prices and tags.
Hello, please change the price tag of {sku} on the market stall to {new_price} from {date}.

nl.Choose in the yellow cell; the rest fill: Kies in de gele cel; de rest wordt automatisch ingevuld. Klaar om af te drukken.
nl.Edit the wording here; words in {braces}: Pas de tekst hier aan; woorden tussen {accolades} worden ingevuld vanuit elke rij. De koppelingen staan in de tabellen.
nl.Choose a record: each step gets its due: Kies een registratie: voor elke stap wordt de uiterste datum berekend. Maak voor elke registratie een kopie van dit werkblad.
nl.Live charts of your sheets. Choose in th: Actuele grafieken op basis van je werkbladen. Kies in de gele cellen en alle grafieken en meters worden automatisch vernieuwd.
